entry.title: Attending the IFAC World Congress 2026, Busan

link.title: Attending the IFAC World Congress 2026, Busan

entry.content: I attended the 23rd IFAC World Congress in Busan, Korea (August 23–28, 2026). It was a good opportunity to follow the latest work in data-driven control and to exchange ideas with researchers from around the world, especially on how these approaches can be applied to aerospace systems.

entry.title: Seminar at Sejong University GNC Lab

link.title: Seminar at Sejong University GNC Lab

entry.content:
I visited Prof. Sung Kyun Hong’s GNC Lab at Sejong University and gave a seminar on fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant control for aerospace systems.

Few research groups in Korea focus on this area, so it was valuable to meet researchers working on similar problems. The discussion after the talk covered data-driven fault diagnosis, fault-tolerant flight control, and verification strategies for safety-critical autonomous systems. I also toured the lab’s hardware-in-the-loop simulation environment and satellite test facilities, a good reminder of how important experimental verification is for moving algorithms onto real hardware.

Thanks to Prof. Hong and the lab members for the warm welcome and the discussion.
entry.summary: I visited Prof. Sung Kyun Hong’s GNC Lab at Sejong University and gave a seminar on fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant control for aerospace systems.

entry.title: Oral presentation at ION Pacific PNT 2026, Honolulu

link.title: Oral presentation at ION Pacific PNT 2026, Honolulu

entry.content:
I presented Federated Extended Kalman Filter Integrating Terrain-Referenced and Quantum Magnetometer-Aided Navigation for GNSS-Denied Environments at the ION Pacific PNT 2026 meeting in Honolulu, Hawaii. The talk addressed the dead zone of quantum magnetometers, one of the main practical challenges in magnetic-anomaly navigation, and how a federated filter with terrain-referenced navigation keeps the solution available.

Co-authors: Minseok Choi, Deok-Young Lee, Daham Kim, Sin Hyuk Yim, Sangkyung Lee, Yoontae Hwang, and Hyochoong Bang.
